description: Real, reported Japanese real-estate transaction prices (and 2021+ agreed/contract prices) from MLIT's 不動産情報ライブラリ. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "property/land prices in Tokyo/Osaka/<Japanese city>", "what did homes sell for in <ward>", Japan housing-market data. Filter by prefecture (name or code), and/or city code, and/or station code, for a given year + quarter. Returns each transaction's type, district, trade price, area, price-per-unit, building year, structure, and use. Coverage: transactions 2005-Q3 onward, agreed prices 2021-Q1 onward.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own free MLIT reinfolib subscription key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

city.description: Optional 5-digit municipality code (from realestate_municipalities), e.g. "13102" (Chuo-ku, Tokyo). Narrows within the prefecture.

prefecture.description: Prefecture name (e.g. "Tokyo", "Osaka") or 2-digit code (01-47). Use this OR city OR station.

price_type.description: Which prices: "transaction" (reported sales), "agreed" (contract prices, 2021+), or omit for both.

station.description: Optional 6-digit rail station code to filter by nearest station.

name: realestate_transactions
title: Realestate Transactions
